title: Barbara NDE 52
content:
WHEN I WAS 41YRS.OLD, I WAS DYING OF LIVER FAILURE AND SUDDEN GASTRIC HEMORRHAGE-REQUIRING 12UNITS OF BLOOD "STAT." I REMEMBER BEING HELPED TO MY BED AND AGONIZING PAIN THROUGH MY ENTIRE BODY AND PROFOUND WEAKNESS. I HAD BEEN IN THE HOSPITAL 2 MOS., AND BY NOW IN THE OPINION OF THE MEDICAL PROFESSION--TERMINAL. I WAS COMPLETELY ORIENTED TO MY SURROUNDINGS AND THE GRAVE CONDITION OF MY BODY--DEPRESSED AND WORRIED. I HAD four CHILDREN AT HOME THAT NEEDED ME. SUDDENLY I BEGAN TO COMPLAIN ABOUT A PIERCING BRIGHT LIGHT IN MY EYES. NOBODY SEEMED TO HELP ME. IT INTENSIFIED. NEXT I NOTICED THAT MY PAIN WAS LEAVING ME--AND I PRESSED MY FINGERS INTO THE SIDE OF MY LEG. MEDICAL EQUIPMENT WAS ALL OVER MY BODY AND I COULD "SEE IT CLEARLY” AND THEN I FELT PARALYZED AND "COOL". NEXT, I COULD SEE EVERY ONE IN THE ENTIRE ROOM--MANY DOCTORS AND OTHERS---AND I FELT "SORRY" FOR THEM. I FELT VERY INTELLIGENT AND MOBILE. I COULD SEE MY HUSBAND COMING INTO THE HOSPITAL ENTRANCE. I LOOKED DOWN AT MYSELF AND I LOOKED VERY SMALL AND UNRECOGNIZABLE. I WONDERED IF THAT WAS REALLY ME. I THAN SEEMED TO BE TRAVELING FEET FIRST AT A VERY FAST SPEED AND EACH TIME I RAISED MY HEAD, I COULD SEE NO END TO THE HALLWAY. SUDDENLY I WAS SURROUNDED BY PROFOUND PEACE, AND WARMTH AND LOVE. THE "SITUATION" WAS SO MAGNETIC AND THE FEELING OF LOVE INTENSE. I WAS NOT AFRAID--I FELT AT HOME AND AT PEACE. THE INTENSE PRESENCE OF LOVE SURROUNDED ME. I HAD SOME "SENSE OF DIRECTION"...IT SEEMED THAT I WAS UNDERSTANDING WHAT TO DO NEXT WITH OUT BEING TOLD. IT SEEMED THAT I HAD MORE "WORK" TO DO--WHICH I WAS GOING TO "CONTINUE ON" IN SOME WAY. I FELT TIRED...AND I HAD NO INTENTIONS OF LEAVING THERE. NEXT, I FELT MY PAIN RETURNING, THEN IT BECAME INTENSE AGAIN, AND I THOUGHT, "I'M BACK"... MY NEXT THOUGHT WAS ---"I'M GOING TO GET BETTER AND THESE PEOPLE DON'T KNOW IT"---I TRIED, BUT I WAS TOO ILL TO SPEAK. LATER I WAS IN INTENSIVE CARE, AND I WAS RELUCTANT TO THINK ABOUT THIS EXPERIENCE...THEN AFTER DISCHARGE WEEKS LATER--I REALIZED THAT I COULDN'T TALK ABOUT THIS TO ANYONE WITHOUT CRYING. I SAW THE DOCTOR EVERY WEEK AND FINALLY GOT THE COURAGE TO TELL HIM. HE SHOOK HIS HEAD AND SAID, "WELL WE THOUGHT YOU WERE GONE TWICE". FOR A LONG TIME I FELT SO CHANGED--I WOULD THINK. "YOU KNOW I'M NOT "ME" ANYMORE. I SIMPLY FELT LIKE A DIFFERENT PERSON--AND I COULDN'T EXPLAIN IT TO ANYONE. IT TOOK ME ONE YEAR TO RECUPERATE--AND DURING MY FIRST WEEK AT HOME, I SLEPT A LOT. I AWOKE LYING FLAT ON MY BED ON MY BACK. I WAS ALONE UPSTAIRS AND I GENERALLY WANTED TO BE WITH SOME ONE TO HELP ME GET OUT OF MY CHAIR ETC. BUT I SAT UPRIGHT ON THE BAD AND LOOKED OVER MY LEFT SHOULDER SUPPORTING MYSELF ON MY HANDS AND IT APPEARED THAT MY BODY WAS STILL LYING ON THE BED AND THAT I HAD "SEPARATED" FROM IT.{!} QUICKLY, I LAID BACK ON THE BED AND REMAINED VERY STILL. I WAS AFRAID TO TRY TO GET UP AND OUT OF BED AGAIN!! I KEEP THIS EPISODE TO MYSELF TOO!!! THIS ALL HAPPENED 20YRS. AGO AND TO THIS DAY I STILL FEEL "DIFFERENT". NOBODY HAS THE HUMAN WORDS TO MAKE ANOTHER HUMAN BEING GENUINELY UNDERSTAND WHAT THIS DOES TO ANOTHER PERSONS LIFE, OR THE DEEPNESS OF OUR FEELINGS. IN VOICING THIS ALL TO ANOTHER IS FRUSTRATING AND YOU ALWAYS KNOW THAT THEY CAN'T POSSIBLY UNDERSTAND, AND ALSO THERE MAY BE SOME SANCTITY LOST. I FEEL MORE TOLERANCE TOWARD EVERY ONE I BELIEVE--BUT IN SOME WAYS, IT SEEMS THAT NO BODY WILL EVER UNDERSTAND. YOU KNOW I FORGOT TO MENTION THAT DURING MY NDE--I SEEMED TO BE A "TOTAL PERSON"_____________I MEAN I DIDN'T SEEM TO BE MISSING AND PART OF MYSELF--I.E. BODY PARTS ETC.:}!--I WAS COMPLETELY UNAWARE OF BEING ANY THING EXCEPT MY TOTAL SELF.. BARBARA ANYMORE!!?? ALSO I THINK I PROTECT MY FEELINGS A LOT MORE THAN I EVER DID BEFORE---I HAVE AN ENTIRE NEW SET OF VALUES IN LIFE...THANKS FOR LISTENING!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! I AM A REGISTERED NURSE, HAD HAD A 3YR.COMMERCIAL ART COURSE, BEFORE MY ILLNESS AND I WAS TAKING NO MEDICATION AT THE TIME OF MY NDE. THERE WAS NO "PREVIEW" OF MY LIFE--- IN FACT WHEN I FIRST PRIVATELY ALLOWED MYSELF TO THINK ABOUT WHAT I HAD EXPERIENCED AND BELIEVING THAT I DID INDEED IN FACT LEAVE MY BODY ETC.-I WAS IMMEDIATELY STRUCK BY THE FACT THAT I FELT COMPLETELY "GUILT FREE"!!!!I WAS RAISED A CATHOLIC, AND THE "YOU'LL BE JUDGED THREAT” AND WAS REMINDED DAILY OF EITHER A "MORTAL OR VENIAL" SIN. BEING GUILTY AND HAVING TO LIVE WITH THE CONSEQUENCES AND GOD BEING ANGRY IN SOME WAY OR ANOTHER, SO I FIGURED THIS WAS A HOPELESS PLIGHT IN LIFE!!!!BUT------------I WAS NOT GUILTY OF A-N-Y-T-H-I-N-G!!!!!!!!I HAD FELT AN EMBRACE AND INCREDIBLE LOVE BEYOND BELIEF!!! I SAW NO ONE BUT I FELT A "MASSIVE PRESENCE" OF WARMTH AND LOVE--A STRONG FEELING OF TOGETHERNESS AND JOY. ALSO I THINK IT'S IMPORTANT TO NOTE THAT ALL MY BLOOD REPORTS {LIVER BLOOD TESTS} WERE COMPLETELY NORMAL THE NEXT DAY AND MY RENAL OUTPUT WAS NORMAL. ALL MY REPORTS CONTINUED TO BE NORMAL FROM THAT DAY ON .I HAD HAD KIDNEY SHUT DOWN BEFORE MY COLLAPSE--OUTPUT ONLY BEING 1CC PER DAY. NOW, MY WEIGHT HAD DROPPED FROM MY NORMAL 140LBS. TO 89LBS. DURING MY HOSPITAL STAY--- BUT I RETURNED TO WORK PART TIME AFTER ONE YEAR STILL THIN AND FRAIL AND HAVING SOME PAIN AS THE DOCTOR SAID I HAD "NARROWING OF MY BONES"-WHAT EVER THAT IS. BUT I'M NOT AFRAID TO ADMIT TO YOU AT THIS TIME IN MY LIFE--THAT WHEN I RETURNED TO WORK, IT ALWAYS SEEMED THAT MY PATIENTS SEEMED IMPROVED WHILE I WAS THERE!!!??? DOES THIS SOUND CRAZY?! HONESTLY, I WOULD BEGIN TO “TEST" IT---AFTER I NOTICED THIS HAPPENING. I WOULD BE ASSIGNED A LOT TO I.C.U., AND IT SEEMED EVEN THE WORST PATIENTS HAD LESS PAIN,-OR RESTED BETTER ETC. EVEN SOME OF MY WORKING FRIENDS WOULD COMMENT ON THIS--AND I WOULD JOKINGLY SAY, "OH, IT'S MY MAGICAL TOUCH"__!! THANK YOU AND I'M ONLY ADDING THESE COMMENTS AS I WANT TO BE HONEST AND COMPLETE WITH THE INFO THAT I OFFER AND WANT YOU TO FIND NEW SUCCESS IN YOUR STUDY OF NDE. THIS INFORMATION DOESN’T REALLY NEED TO BE ADDED TO MY FIRST INFO THAT I SENT YOU. I SIMPLY THOUGHT IT MAY BE OF VALUE TO YOUR RESEARCH.

demographics.occupation: Registered nurse (also had 3-year commercial art course)

diagnosis.diagnosis_raw: Dying of liver failure and sudden gastric hemorrhage; had kidney shut down (renal output 1cc/day) prior to collapse.
diagnosis.disease_name: Liver failure with sudden gastric hemorrhage; acute kidney shutdown/renal failure
diagnosis.severity_description: Terminal per medical profession; hospitalized 2 months; required 12 units of blood STAT; profound weakness and agonizing pain; renal output 1cc/day prior to collapse.
diagnosis.quality_of_life_impact: Agonizing whole-body pain, profound weakness; needed help getting out of chair after discharge; slept a lot first week at home; thin and frail on return to work.
diagnosis.lab_values: Renal output was 1cc/day prior to collapse; liver blood tests were completely normal the next day; renal output normal thereafter.
diagnosis.mobility_status: Needed help getting out of chair after discharge; thin and frail.

treatment.treatments_raw: Hospitalized (2 months); required 12 units of blood 'STAT'; intensive care afterward; medical equipment all over body.

remission_outcome.time_to_remission_raw: Liver blood tests completely normal the next day; renal output normal; reports continued to be normal from that day on.
remission_outcome.verification_detail: Patient reports liver blood tests were completely normal the next day and remained normal thereafter; renal output normalized after being 1cc/day prior to collapse.
remission_outcome.physician_quote: "Well we thought you were gone twice".
remission_outcome.biomarker_trajectory: Liver blood tests abnormal/failed → completely normal next day; renal output 1cc/day → normal.
remission_outcome.follow_up_duration_raw: Experience happened 20 years ago; she still feels different; reports remained normal from that day on.

intuition_examples: Felt she had a 'sense of direction' and understood what to do next without being told
Returned with conviction: 'I'm going to get better and these people don't know it'
turner_factors.intuition_details: During NDE she felt guided and after returning she had a strong inner knowing she would recover.
turner_factors.emotional_release_details: After discharge she could not talk about the experience without crying; later disclosed to her doctor. Also described profound shift to feeling completely guilt-free.
turner_factors.spiritual_practices_raw: Raised Catholic; experienced 'massive presence' of warmth and love; discussed sanctity of experience; no explicit prayer practice described.
purpose_sources: Four children at home that needed her
Sense of having more 'work' to do
turner_factors.purpose_details: Strong motivation to return for her children; during NDE felt she had more work to do and would continue on in some way.

pre_illness_state.pre_illness_description: While terminally ill in hospital she was depressed and worried, oriented to her grave condition; had four children at home needing her; later reflected on being raised with strong guilt/judgment framework in Catholic upbringing.
pre_illness_state.stress_description: Terminal illness and prolonged hospitalization; worry about children at home.

existential_shift.identity_shift_description: Felt she was not 'me' anymore; felt like a different person; had new set of values; more tolerance toward everyone; felt 'total person' during NDE.
existential_shift.transformation_narrative: Profound peace/love during NDE; returned feeling guilt-free and fundamentally changed with new values and greater tolerance; ongoing sense of difference 20 years later.
existential_shift.pivot_point_description: NDE with intense light, out-of-body perception, travel through hallway, and immersion in profound love/peace; returned with conviction of recovery.
existential_shift.transformation_timing: NDE occurred during collapse/terminal event; next-day labs normalized and remained normal afterward.
major_life_changes: Returned to work part-time after one year (still thin/frail)

anomalous_experience.experience_description: During terminal collapse: intense light, analgesia, paralysis/coolness, out-of-body perception of room and husband arriving, rapid travel through seemingly endless hallway, immersion in profound peace/warmth/love; returned to body with pain; later had an episode at home where she perceived separation from her body while in bed (OBE-like).
anomalous_experience.experience_timing: During hospitalization/terminal event; additional OBE-like episode during first week at home.

correspondential_markers.self_attack_description: Described strong guilt/judgment framework from Catholic upbringing; after NDE felt completely guilt-free.
correspondential_markers.resolution_type: Shift from guilt/fear to guilt-free state with profound love/peace; enduring values change and increased tolerance.

validation.statistical_improbability_notes: Narrative claims abrupt normalization of liver blood tests and renal output the day after being considered terminal with liver failure, gastric hemorrhage, and near-anuric renal shutdown.
validation.extraction_notes: No specific diagnosis etiology (e.g., cirrhosis, hepatitis) or imaging/biopsy data provided; remission described via lab normalization and urine output, but no numeric liver panel values. Conventional care included transfusions and ICU support, so not 'pure spontaneous'.

analysis.case_summary: At age 41, patient hospitalized for two months with terminal liver failure and sudden gastric hemorrhage, with prior kidney shutdown (1cc/day urine) and massive transfusion need. During collapse she had an NDE/OBE and returned with conviction she would recover; she reports liver blood tests and renal output normalized the next day and remained normal thereafter, with a year-long recovery.
key_healing_factors: Near-death experience with profound peace/love and guilt-free shift
Purpose (four children; sense of more work to do)
Emotional catharsis and enduring values/identity change
unique_features: Reported next-day normalization of liver blood tests and renal output after terminal status
Later OBE-like episode at home during early recovery
Perceived 'healing presence' effect on ICU patients after returning to nursing work
analysis.analysis_notes: This is a radical recovery from multi-organ failure/hemorrhage rather than cancer; outcome is supported by self-reported lab normalization and a physician remark but lacks named institutions/dates/values.
